profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer specializing in applications and frameworks for Apple platforms. Built a large-scale eCommerce app from the ground up and led an international team of developers to successfully build and deploy a suite of Swift frameworks for iOS, watchOS, and Linux.

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Completed a total re-write of the Sysco Shop app from React Native to native iOS, from a blank Xcode project to app store deployment
•  Made key decisions on Sysco Shop's architecture, documentation, and coding best practices
•  Set up a CI/CD pipeline with Bitrise, Codecov, Apple profiles and certificates, and Bash scripts

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Led the development of the Swift/iOS SDKs for IBM Watson and IBM Bluemix Mobile Services
•  Created the standards and development guidelines by which IBM developers create and maintain Swift frameworks, helping to onboard new developers
• Enhanced productivity by automating the testing, documentation, and release process for the iOS frameworks using Travis-CI
•  Integrated the IBM Cloud Developer website with a new REST API
•  Enabled A/B testing in the IBM Cloud Developer website by integrating Optimizely

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•  Took full ownership of the Mi-Token iOS app for two-factor authentication
•  Added Japanese localization to better leverage our partnerships with Japanese corporations
•  Overhauled the UI to provide users with a more consistent design that conformed to new
iOS 7 design guidelines

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.locationName: The University of Texas at Austin
positions.description: Theoretical cosmology. Estimating the impacts of x-rays on primordial minihalos in the early universe.

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Determined the properties of binary stars from observational data.

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description: Undergraduate learning assistant for General Physics II. My duties consisted of assisting the professor during lecture and leading two hour discussion sessions twice per week.

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Calculus tutor
positions.description: Online tutoring of high school and college students.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

honors.title: Open Source Leader
honors.description: Awarded for holding a leadership position in an IBM-strategic open source community. I kickstarted and led the development effort for the Swift SDKs in IBM Bluemix Mobile Services.
honors.issuer: Issued by IBM Open Source Recognition Program · Dec 2016

honors.title: Summer Research Fellowship
honors.description: Awarded to fund my research on the impact of x-rays on primordial minihalos during the summer of 2012.
honors.issuer: Issued by College of Natural Sciences · Apr 2012

projects.title: Astronomy Honors Thesis
projects.description: The Impact of X-rays on Primordial Minihalos
